name: Cale Highguard
source: Warm and kind to most, Cale is a gentle person who enjoys introversion. He's known for being a good cook, along with having a good amount of intelligence. He hails from Nephrine, but has moved to Dreilune to attend Tsukimiya Academy for the sake of his own future.
